parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
assess[əses]v.
To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.
→ She assessed the condition of the toy car before buying it.
2
astonish[əstɑniʃ]v.
To astonish someone means to greatly surprise them.
→ The amount of people that came to her party astonished her.
3
commence[kəmens]v.
To commence something means to begin it.
→ His speech commenced with a “thank you” to all who had helped him succeed.
4
essence[esəns]n.
The essence of something is its important qualities or basic characteristics.
→ The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
5
extract[ikstrækt]v.
To extract something means to remove it.
→ The dentist extracted the woman’s damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
6
fabulous[fæbjələs]adj.
If something is fabulous, it is extremely good.
→ This strawberry is the best I’ve ever had. It’s fabulous.
7
haste[heist]n.
Haste is speed in movement or action.
→ In order to get to the meeting in time, he proceeds with haste.
8
impulse[impʌls]n.
An impulse is a sudden thoughtless urge to do something.
→ Because of the scary noise, she had an impulse to run somewhere and hide.
9
latter[lætər]adj.
Latter describes something last in a series or the second choice of two things.
→ In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
10
molecule[mɑləkju:l]n.
A molecule is the smallest basic unit that makes up a physical substance.
→ A tiny drop of water is made up of thousands of molecules of water.
11
ongoing[ɑngouiŋ]adj.
If something is ongoing, then it is still happening or still growing.
→ The development of plants is ongoing because it takes time for them to mature.
12
pharmaceutical[fɑ:rməsu:tikəl]adj.
If something is pharmaceutical, then it is related to the development of drugs.
→ Pharmaceutical companies discover new cures to illnesses all the time.
13
precise[prisais]adj.
If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.
→ The builder was very precise about where he placed the nails.
14
proximity[prɑksiməti]n.
Proximity is closeness in time, space, or relationships.
→ All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.
15
publicity[pʌblisəti]n.
Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.
→ She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
16
remedy[remədi]n.
A remedy is a cure for a disease, argument, or problem.
→ A good remedy for a headache is an aspirin and a glass of water.
17
significance[signifikəns]n.
The significance of something is the quality that makes it important.
→ The significance of the snowy weather was that we didn’t have to go to school.
18
subsequent[sʌbsikwənt]adj.
If something is subsequent, then it comes after something else in time.
→ The flood and the subsequent rescue of those caught in the flood were on TV.
19
synthetic[sinθetik]adj.
If something is synthetic, then it is made to be like something natural.
→ Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
20
terminal[tə:rmənəl]adj.
If something is terminal, then it causes or results in death.
→ Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: remedy
questions.explanation: remedy (phương thuốc, cách chữa trị) trái nghĩa với poison (chất độc).

questions.content: latter
questions.explanation: latter (cái sau, thứ hai) trái nghĩa với first (đầu tiên).

questions.content: terminal
questions.explanation: terminal (gây tử vong, vô phương cứu chữa) trái nghĩa với curable (có thể chữa khỏi).

questions.content: commence
questions.explanation: commence (bắt đầu) trái nghĩa với finish (kết thúc).

questions.content: precise
questions.explanation: precise (chính xác, tỉ mỉ) trái nghĩa với messy (bừa bộn, cẩu thả).

questions.content: synthetic
questions.explanation: synthetic (nhân tạo) trái nghĩa với natural (tự nhiên).

questions.content: extract
questions.explanation: extract (chiết xuất, rút ra) trái nghĩa với insert (chèn vào, nhét vào).

questions.content: publicity
questions.explanation: publicity (sự chú ý của công chúng) trái nghĩa với privacy (sự riêng tư).

questions.content: impulse
questions.explanation: impulse (sự bốc đồng, không suy nghĩ) trái nghĩa với plan (kế hoạch, có tính toán).

questions.content: fabulous
questions.explanation: fabulous (tuyệt vời) trái nghĩa với awful (tồi tệ).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.content: The patient’s illness seemed like it might be _____________.
questions.explanation: Bệnh tình của bệnh nhân có vẻ như vô phương cứu chữa (terminal).

questions.content: To save him, doctors had to ______________the infected tissue.
questions.explanation: Bác sĩ phải cắt bỏ (extract) phần mô bị nhiễm trùng.

questions.content: On an _____________, he kicked the wall and it revealed a secret pass.
questions.explanation: Theo một sự bốc đồng (on an impulse), anh ta đá vào tường.

questions.content: It led to his ______________ escape from the prison.
questions.explanation: Dẫn đến cuộc vượt ngục sau đó (subsequent) của anh ta.

questions.content: It was difficult to ______________ in which direction the forest fire would go.
questions.explanation: Thật khó để đánh giá (assess) hướng cháy rừng.

questions.content: One reason was that anything could happen while the fire was _____________.
questions.explanation: Trong khi đám cháy đang diễn ra (ongoing).

questions.content: The ______________ of the mayor’s speech was about building the new library.
questions.explanation: Bản chất/ý chính (essence) của bài phát biểu.

questions.content: The building would be a(n) _____________ addition to the scenery downtown.
questions.explanation: Sự bổ sung tuyệt vời (fabulous).

questions.content: His amazing skills during the last half of the game _____________ the crowd.
questions.explanation: Kỹ năng tuyệt vời đã làm kinh ngạc (astonished) đám đông.

questions.content: Then that night, he received a lot of ______________ from all the news shows.
questions.explanation: Nhận được nhiều sự chú ý (publicity) từ truyền thông.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
Because she took the test with such speed, she made several silly mistakes. [ 21 ]

Her anniversary had a quality that made it important because it was also her birthday. [ 22 ]

Though the smallest basic units in ice and steam are similar, their shapes are different. [ 23 ]

They began the ceremony at 9:00 in the evening. [ 24 ]

The closeness in space of her office is only a short distance from mine. [ 25 ]

He could sleep late that day or get up early and start his work. He chose the second choice. [ 26 ]

The noises on the computer sounded like they were made to sound like real ones. [ 27 ]

Please judge the quality of his proposal before we decide to meet with him. [ 28 ]

The best cure for a slightly injured foot is putting ice on it. [ 29 ]

Most of the advertisements on TV are related to the development of drugs commercials. [ 30 ]
questions.explanation: speed (tốc độ) tương đương với haste (sự vội vã).
quality that made it important tương đương significance (ý nghĩa quan trọng).
smallest basic units tương đương molecules (phân tử).
began (bắt đầu) tương đương commenced.
closeness in space tương đương proximity (sự gần gũi).
second choice (sự lựa chọn thứ hai) tương đương latter.
made to sound like real ones (làm giả giống thật) tương đương synthetic (nhân tạo).
judge the quality (đánh giá chất lượng) tương đương assess.
cure (cách chữa trị) tương đương remedy.
related to the development of drugs tương đương pharmaceutical.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
A Famous Accident

One of the greatest pharmaceutical discoveries happened by accident. In his haste to go on vacation, Alexander Fleming had left his laboratory in a mess. The essence of his ongoing work involved a type of bacteria. An infection caused by the bacteria was often terminal, and he was looking for a remedy. He had left the bacteria out while he was away.

When he returned from vacation, he found that his lab was covered in fungus. He started cleaning up the mess. While he was cleaning, he had an impulse to examine the fungus. He saw that whenever the fungus was in close proximity to the bacteria, the bacteria died.

Though he was a messy scientist, his experiments were precise. He thought that there might be some significance to the fungus. He immediately commenced an experiment to assess what had happened to the bacteria. It had either died by accident or the fungus had killed it. The subsequent tests proved it was the latter reason.

What he found astonished him. The fungus actually killed the bad bacteria. All this time, he had been looking for a synthetic material to kill the bacteria. Instead, a common fungus did the job.

He knew that something in the fungus had killed the bacteria. His next step was to find those molecules that had done it. When he found them, he extracted them and put them into a pill. The drug proved to be very effective. It also worked against other types of harmful bacteria.

The discovery received a lot of publicity. Soon after, the new drug was being used all over the world. Because of the success, the scientist was able to develop even more fabulous drugs to help people. His accidental discovery changed the world and helped save many people’s lives.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True (T) or False (F).

questions.content: One of the most fabulous pharmaceutical discoveries was an accident.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 1, "One of the greatest pharmaceutical discoveries happened by accident." (Một trong những khám phá dược phẩm vĩ đại nhất đã xảy ra một cách tình cờ).

questions.content: The essence of the scientist’s ongoing work was to find a remedy for a terminal infection.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 1, "The essence of his ongoing work... An infection caused by the bacteria was often terminal, and he was looking for a remedy." (Bản chất công việc đang diễn ra của ông... Một căn bệnh nhiễm trùng do vi khuẩn gây ra thường dẫn đến tử vong, và ông đang tìm kiếm một phương thuốc).

questions.content: The infection caused by the bacteria he was working on was not terminal.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Trong đoạn 1 có viết: "An infection caused by the bacteria was often terminal" (Một căn bệnh nhiễm trùng do vi khuẩn gây ra thường dẫn đến tử vong).

questions.content: Fleming examined the fungus on an impulse.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 2, "While he was cleaning, he had an impulse to examine the fungus." (Trong khi dọn dẹp, ông bỗng nảy ra ý định kiểm tra nấm).

questions.content: Whenever the synthetic material was far from the bacteria, the bacteria died.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Cuối đoạn 2 ghi: "whenever the fungus was in close proximity to the bacteria, the bacteria died." (bất cứ khi nào nấm ở gần vi khuẩn, vi khuẩn sẽ chết). Vật liệu tổng hợp (synthetic material) và việc ở xa (far) là sai.

questions.content: In his haste to go on vacation, how had Alexander Fleming left his laboratory?
options: In his haste to go on vacation, Alexander Fleming left his laboratory in a mess.
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 1, "In his haste to go on vacation, Alexander Fleming had left his laboratory in a mess." (Trong lúc vội vã đi nghỉ, Alexander Fleming đã để phòng thí nghiệm của mình trong tình trạng bừa bộn).

questions.content: What was the significance of the fungus?
options: The significance of the fungus was that it could kill the bacteria.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 4, "The fungus actually killed the bad bacteria." (Loại nấm này thực sự đã tiêu diệt được vi khuẩn xấu).

questions.content: When did the scientist get an impulse to examine the fungus?
options: While he was cleaning, he had an impulse to examine the fungus.
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 2, "While he was cleaning, he had an impulse to examine the fungus." (Trong khi dọn dẹp, ông bỗng nảy ra ý định kiểm tra nấm).

questions.content: What did the scientist extract molecules from?
options: The scientist extracted molecules from the fungus.
He extracted them from the bacteria.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn 5, "He knew that something in the fungus had killed the bacteria... When he found them, he extracted them..." (Ông biết rằng thứ gì đó trong nấm đã giết chết vi khuẩn... Khi tìm thấy chúng, ông đã chiết xuất chúng...).

questions.content: What received a lot of publicity?
options: The discovery received a lot of publicity.
His vacation received a lot of publicity.
His messy lab received a lot of publicity.
The bacteria received a lot of publicity.
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 6, "The discovery received a lot of publicity." (Khám phá này đã nhận được rất nhiều sự chú ý của công chúng).
